# coupled-mode solution.
#

# Soc. Am. 77, 983-988 (1985)) with ONE change: the bottom density is 1.5 instead of 2.5.
# Isovelocity water 1500 m/s, density 1.0, 100 m deep, over a homogeneous fluid bottom
# 1704.5 m/s, density 1.5, 0.5 dB/wavelength; the same square wave between 5 and 10 km.
# Source 18 m, receiver 50 m.
#

# changed: 120 modes, cylindrical geometry, 101 regions, the fully two-way solution (IOUT = 0),
